carrier_policy.thread_overview: thread/list follows the Codex-visible default source set with sortKey=updated_at sortDirection=desc
carrier_policy.thread_history: thread/read includeTurns=true by canonical Codex thread id

functional_mvp.codex_protocol: JSON-RPC newline transport with initialize, model/list, permissionProfile/list, skills/list, plugin/installed, app/installed, paginated thread/list, thread/read, thread/resume, thread/fork, thread/archive, thread/unarchive, turn/start, turn/steer, thread/status/changed, item/agentMessage/delta, item/completed, and turn/completed
functional_mvp.codex_model_reasoning_controls: The build dynamically injects the App product profile default, complete ordered visible-model allowlist, labels, and reasoning options; runtime model/list follows cursors through the terminal page, filters unadvertised fixed alternatives, and keeps unavailable fixed selections blocked but cannot veto the App default route, the root Auto recommendation action resolves the injected default model and default reasoning effort as one policy, manual reasoning pins the resolved model and exits Auto, and turn/start receives model and effort overrides
functional_mvp.native_bridge: Electron contextBridge window.oplStudio over allowlisted ipcRenderer.invoke
functional_mvp.agent_permissions_controls: The composer exposes Codex permission profiles as Full access, Workspace access, and Read only; Full access is the candidate default, and the selected profile is sent through Desktop and WebUI to thread/start, thread/resume, and turn/start without a parallel sandbox field
functional_mvp.shared_thread_directory: Codex-visible conversation overview via thread/list without a Studio-only storage filter, sorted by updated_at desc; history opens read-only by the same thread id with includeTurns=true
functional_mvp.settings_persistence: localStorage model with SETTINGS_STORAGE_KEY, settingsDefaults, readSettings, writeSettings, readRuntimeProfile, and no system write permission
functional_mvp.execute_confirmation: settings_actions_preflight_then_confirm; projected contribution commands use descriptor_confirmation_required then canonical execute with fresh App state readback
functional_mvp.typed_runtime_readback_surface: normalized readState/readFullDrilldown envelopes with runtime profile, app_state/drilldown payload, and command readback metadata
functional_mvp.typed_action_receipt_surface: normalized action receipts with requested mode, command args, parsed stdout/stderr JSON, and receipt status
functional_mvp.typed_event_surface: typed bridge events with process/tool/file/diff/receipt/user_input/permission classification across native bridge and web SSE
functional_mvp.artifact_preview_mvp: rich refs-only preview adapters for markdown, math, mermaid, code, and pdf
functional_mvp.professional_starters_mvp: research, grant, presentation, and review shortcuts route to real App preview refs; they are not forms or domain execution
functional_mvp.agent_package_lifecycle_display: the Settings catalog consumes app_state.agent_packages directory/status_index first, falls back to modules.items as preview-only, and exposes only App/root action refs
functional_mvp.thread_lifecycle: one Desktop/WebUI adapter projects Codex App Server thread truth and routes list, read, resume, fork, archive, and unarchive without a second thread store
functional_mvp.codex_subagent_projection: read-only parentThreadId, agentRole, agentNickname, source-kind, collabAgentToolCall, and subAgentActivity projection from Codex App Server thread and turn items

default_home_layout.policy: ordinary home uses the directly reused DeepSeek Harness chat-first composition baseline: workspace rail visible, conversation dominant, composer persistent, and secondary context closed until requested

primary_visual_reference.left_side: persistent project and conversation rail with search and Settings only
primary_visual_reference.center: single dominant conversation timeline with bottom composer
primary_visual_reference.right_side: on-demand DSH details column for run status, files and results, and agents and capabilities

webui_transport.events: GET /api/opl-events uses SSE for Codex App Server and typed host events
webui_transport.thread_adapter: scripts/webui-host/host-core.mjs with Electron IPC and loopback HTTP/SSE adapters over codex app-server stdio
webui_transport.subagent_projection: Codex-owned lineage, agent metadata, source kind, collabAgentToolCall, and subAgentActivity are rendered read-only

adopted_patterns: SlotCore typed slot registry and disposer lifecycle
createSlotRenderer React composition and entry error isolation
byte-identical AppFrame SidebarRoot WorkspaceBrowser ConversationRoot EmptyHero InputBar AgentPresetSeat and SettingsRoot GUI source plus the DSH Menu primitive

model and reasoning controls in the composer bottom row

reused_oss_module_policy.required_boundary: run the pinned DeepSeek Harness Cordis application skeleton and GUI source with OPL-owned plugins; expose DSH ctx.tools to the persistent Codex App Server through authenticated loopback MCP; derive the browser Client Cordis graph from Framework Host projection plus App profile and slot policy; do not load dsh-base or adopt DSH session, LLM-provider, agent-loop, credential, domain, Package-currentness, product, or release authority

settings_information_architecture.heading_policy: the sidebar shows the primary group once; the current destination owns the only page heading; sibling destinations use one compact navigation control without repeating the active label

gateway_access_state_policy.none: show the OPL Gateway and API Key setup choices without an account detail skeleton
gateway_access_state_policy.manual_key: show the configured API Key summary and an explicit change-access action; never show Gateway balance, usage, or device rows
gateway_access_state_policy.account: show the projected Gateway identity, balance, usage, device, freshness, and owner actions; hide credential inputs until the user explicitly chooses to change access
gateway_access_state_policy.unknown_or_error: show a neutral loading or unavailable state and preserve any valid public last-known-good account projection; never infer disconnected state

secondary_runtime_context_refs.source: Runtime page and secondary context surfaces only

webui_parity.sse_subscription_surface: subscribeEvents uses GET /api/opl-events and normalizes message payloads to typed bridge events

bridge_readback_contract.placeholder_action_receipt_policy: browser fallback placeholder receipts are preview-only, non-executable, and must not emit preview_ready with canExecute=true without a real native/App action record
bridge_readback_contract.event_surface: normalize native bridge payloads and web SSE payloads before UI consumption

agent_package_lifecycle_display.display_policy: canonical agent_packages projection first; legacy modules fallback is preview-only and cannot infer installed, ready, synced, release, or package truth

workbench_model_live_derivation.starter_payload_policy: starter payload fields must derive from live action payload_fields plus task/module refs when available
workbench_model_live_derivation.receipt_ref_policy: receipt summaries and preview refs must derive from task_drilldowns action_receipt review_receipt and artifact_or_blocker surfaces
workbench_model_live_derivation.context_policy: context sources and actions must prefer live App state refs over static candidate copy while staying refs-only
